Australia's security environment has never been more complex. With vast maritime borders spanning critical Indo-Pacific sea lanes and an increasingly contested regional landscape, the demands on Australia's maritime defence capabilities are growing at pace. Meeting those demands requires more than advanced technology – it requires partners who are genuinely invested in Australia's long-term security.


L3Harris Technologies is proud to be one of those partners.


### A Trusted Partner in Australia's Maritime Future


L3Harris has a proven history of supporting Australia's maritime capabilities, working alongside the Royal Australian Navy, the Australian Border Force and key industry partners to deliver systems and solutions that underpin Australia's ability to operate effectively across its maritime domain.


From advanced sonar and underwater systems to communications, electronic warfare and surveillance technologies, L3Harris brings an integrated and battle-tested portfolio to Australia's most complex maritime challenges. These are not capabilities imported from overseas programs. They are co-developed with Australian partners to perform when and where they are needed most, across the full spectrum of maritime operations from constabulary and border protection missions to high-intensity conflict.
